note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Extra keys (note, followup, manual_prepare, manual_teardown) are for the recorder person; the kit ignores them. Every python command opens its own MSAL interactive sign-in (the token cache is in memory): the owner signs in as labadmin when the browser asks, or exports the app-registration variables in the shell before recording (never in a file). Record bpfkit-report (backfill) first, then bpfkit-status, as demo.md says; the queue order here follows script.yaml.
prepare: if (-not $env:DATAVERSE_URL) { throw 'Set $env:DATAVERSE_URL to the lab environment URL in this shell first (the owner does this; it is never written in a file).' }
manual_prepare: Solution MGLabDataverse: create BPF 'Project Approval' on Project Request (Submit, condition Budget >= 50000, Finance Review, Approve, Close) and activate it.
Open PR-0004 once in the app and note whether the form creates an instance; PR-0004 Budget 75,000, PR-0001 Budget 42,000.
Optionally move PR-0002 and PR-0004 to Finance Review and PR-0001 to Approve with bpfkit next before the report.

screens.name: bpf-designer
steps: Open the business process flow 'Project Approval'
Zoom / mini-map so the whole flow fits: Submit, the condition, Finance Review, Approve, Close
Show Budget marked Required in Submit and Business Justification required in Finance Review
mask: tenant name in the top bar
environment name and org URL (address bar and header)
user e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: bpfkit-status
prepare: Push-Location src; python -m bpfkit back --code PR-0004 2>&1 | Out-Null; Pop-Location
screens.note: The screen prepare moves PR-0004 back to Submit so the scene can be repeated.

screens.name: app-bpf
steps: Select DEV, Apps, open the model-driven app with Project Request
Process bar: Project Approval, Submit completed, Finance Review active
Open the stage flyout: Business Justification (required) and Due Date
mask: tenant name in the top bar
environment name and org URL (address bar and header)
user e-mail and avatar in the account menu

manual_teardown: Optionally delete the Project Approval instances.
Deactivate then delete the Project Approval BPF; check Tables and delete the instance table if still listed.
Keep Business Justification and the episode 1 data if later episodes use them.
needs: licence:Power Apps Premium (BPF use rights, lab trial)
